app.name: OTAbridge
app.tagline: Property management for people who manage properties for other people.
app.claim: Every night, on every channel, from one desk.
app.claimBody: Rates, availability and bookings stay right across Airbnb, Booking.com and your own site, and the people who clean, host and own the places see exactly what they need.
app.fact1: Local rates and availability are the truth; the channels mirror them
app.fact2: Owner statements that add up to the cent, every month
app.fact3: Direct bookings with no commission, on your own domain
app.footer: Fair-code software. Self-host it or let us run it.

shortcuts.whyBody: Airbnb has no shortcuts and no palette; Guesty and Smoobu neither. A manager with 15 units touches the calendar and the inbox fifty times a day, so this is where speed is felt. The letters follow Gmail and Linear, which most hosts already know.

Channel commission, tax the channel withheld and approved expenses come off as their own lines, each with its source and receipt. The management fee is computed last, on the basis the agreement names, and the owner sees the same lines on the portal.

apiKeys.title: API & AI
apiKeys.intro: Let Claude run the day-to-day with you: read the calendar and reservations, change prices and availability, answer guests and reviews. Claude cannot reach Airbnb, Booking.com or your other channels on its own; OTAbridge is that connection. Create a key, then connect Claude below.
apiKeys.testNotice: While OTAbridge is in test, what Claude does through a key happens at once, with no confirmation step. Every action is checked against the key's access and written to the activity log as “via API key”.
apiKeys.stepUp: A key cannot re-enter a password, so nothing that asks a person to confirm their password (payouts, refunds, card details, deleting a property, managing people or keys) is ever available to a key.
apiKeys.createHint: One key per assistant or script, so you can revoke one without touching the others.
apiKeys.name: Key name
apiKeys.nameHint: Shown in the activity log: “via API key ‘Claude’”.

levelHint.full: everything a host does day to day: calendar, reservations, guests, reviews.
levelHint.read_only: can look at everything, change nothing.
levelHint.messages: read and answer guests and reviews; no prices, no bookings.
levelHint.prices: read the calendar, change prices, availability and minimum stays.
